items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In this paper, we modify the (
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>s</jats:italic>
                    ) fractional integral operator involving
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    -Mittag-Leffler function and discuss its properties. We originate a new fractional operator named (
                    <jats:italic>k</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>s</jats:italic>
                    )-Prabhakar derivative and obtained some classical fractional operators as a special case of the newly proposed derivative. Some properties of the introduced operator are also part of the present work. The generalized Laplace transform is employed to study the characteristics of fractional operators. We modeled the free-electron laser (FEL) equation by involving the proposed derivative and can find the solution by using the said Laplace transform.
                  </jats:p>
title: On certain fractional calculus operators and applications in mathematical physics

items.abstract:
<jats:p>We study fractional variational problems in terms of a generalized fractional integral with
Lagrangians depending on classical derivatives, generalized fractional integrals and derivatives. We obtain necessary optimality conditions for the basic and isoperimetric problems, as
well as natural boundary conditions for free‐boundary value problems. The fractional action‐like variational approach (FALVA) is extended and some applications to physics discussed.</jats:p>
title: Fractional Calculus of Variations in Terms of a Generalized Fractional Integral with Applications to Physics
